findings.title: SSH is open to the internet on both droplets (admin_ip_ranges default 0.0.0.0/0 and CI never overrides it)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: admin_ip_ranges has no default + non-empty validation (variables.tf:76-92); CI fails empty/world-open allowlists before plan/apply (terraform-do.yml:102-113, :241-248); DO firewall restricts 22 to the list (firewall.tf:18-22).

findings.title: Terraform state-locking fix is incompatible with the pinned Terraform version (use_lockfile requires >= 1.10, workflows pin 1.9)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: providers.tf requires >= 1.15 and sets use_lockfile=true; terraform-do.yml pins 1.15.9.

findings.title: Prometheus alert rules have no delivery path (no Alertmanager)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: alertmanager service (docker-compose.yml:310-369) + prometheus alerting block (prometheus.yml:14-17) + watchdog rule; prod deploys fail closed without the external watchdog URL (deploy-do.yml:838-850).

findings.title: Dev droplet capacity is under-provisioned and the CI value drifts from dev.tfvars.example
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: CI dev size s-1vcpu-2gb (terraform-do.yml:84) matches env/dev.tfvars.example; prod s-2vcpu-2gb.

findings.title: Operations documentation contradicts the current pipeline and configuration
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: infra/digitalocean/README.md, docs/ROLLBACK_PROCEDURES.md:236-256 and docs/RELEASING.md describe the current manual-dispatch Terraform, digest-pinned stack and prod-approval gate.

findings.title: Integration/security env vars referenced by the app schema are not delivered by the deploy pipeline
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: deploy printf + envs deliver the integration/security vars (deploy-do.yml:735, :763-815); scripts/check-env-parity.mjs runs clean; compose reads them.

findings.title: Redis container hardening was weakened and its password remains in process arguments
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: cap_drop ALL + no-new-privileges + user redis + entrypoint file/env password (no argv), RDB-only persistence (docker-compose.yml:34-71).

findings.title: Manual rollback script cannot authenticate to GHCR and defaults to the wrong image prefix
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: scripts/rollback.sh logs in to GHCR from the caller (token via stdin), prefix ghcr.io/mainecybertech/mainecybertech (:34), pinned host key with explicit last-resort opt-in (:47-64); shellcheck-gated.

findings.title: Deploy health gate ignores the monitoring and reverse-proxy containers
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: GATED_SERVICES=redis api worker web alertmanager prometheus caddy with per-service logs on failure (deploy-do.yml:1059-1085).

findings.title: `env/prod.tfvars` is tracked despite an ignore rule that names it
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: only env/prod.tfvars.example tracked; gitignore covers it.

findings.title: Restore test uses a different Postgres major than the backup script and verifies only table counts
findings.note: fixed at 7dd0402: both the backup script (scripts/backup-database.sh:52) and the restore test (db-restore-test.yml:177) use the same digest-pinned postgres:16-alpine; the restore test asserts table/migration/row/freshness/RLS floors (:196-330). (Previously partially-fixed.)

findings.title: `docs/RTO_RPO.md` claims Redis AOF persistence that compose does not enable
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/RTO_RPO.md:12 documents Redis RDB-snapshot-only (RPO 24h) matching compose (redis-data volume, no AOF).

findings.title: `infra/terraform/README.md` references an `aws/` directory that does not exist
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: no aws/ reference remains in infra/terraform/README.md.

findings.title: Terraform is manual-dispatch only, so the "push to trigger apply" rollback runbook step is a no-op
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/ROLLBACK_PROCEDURES.md:236-256 documents the manual-dispatch-only reality and the Actions dispatch procedure.

findings.title: infra/digitalocean/.env.example omits the alerting and internal-metrics variables the compose stack reads
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: .env.example includes METRICS_TOKEN (:111) and the ALERTMANAGER_* block (:117-129).

findings.title: Terraform tfvars generated/referenced at the module root are not covered by the .gitignore rule
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: .gitignore:63 adds infra/terraform/**/*.tfvars (examples stay tracked).

findings.title: Cloud-init UFW SSH allowlist is applied only at droplet creation, so narrowed allowlists leave stale host rule
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: documented as create-time + DO firewall authoritative (cloud-init.yml:17-27, firewall.tf:12-20) with a refresh procedure (infra/terraform/README.md:19-45).

findings.title: METRICS_TOKEN has no fail-closed deploy guard; an empty token leaves the API scrape permanently down
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: prod deploy fails on an empty METRICS_TOKEN (deploy-do.yml:824-835); the token file is written 0400 to the prometheus user (:836-841).

findings.title: Prometheus alert-rule unit tests exist but are not run in CI
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: prometheus-rules composite runs promtool check + test against the digest-pinned prom/prometheus image in test.yml:52 and validate.yml:50.
